issues.legal_issue: A plaint may be rejected under Order VII Rule 11 of the Code of Civil Procedure when, on a meaningful reading of its averments, the suit is manifestly barred by limitation or does not disclose a cause of action.
Registration of a sale deed gives constructive notice of the transaction, supporting the presumption that persons claiming an interest in the property had notice of it.
A partition suit filed decades after a family partition and registered sale deeds, without pleading when the claimants learned of those transactions, is barred by limitation.
